name: orbit-sentinel-mcp
description: Search 190,000+ space regulatory filings and comments from the FCC, ITU, UNOOSA and FAA.
long_description: Orbit Sentinel provides 22 tools over 190,000+ space regulatory filings and public comments, with 300,000+ documents, from the FCC, ITU, UNOOSA and FAA: semantic search, entity dossiers (filings + SEC + sanctions screening), spectrum ranges from the FCC's own records (through June 2025), launch licenses, and filing trends and distributions. A thin open-source (MIT) stdio client of the Orbit Sentinel REST API. Get a free beta API key via magic-link signup at https://console.viventine.com. Not endorsed or certified by the FCC or any other agency.
